one_line: Afghan ruler who transformed the Grand Trunk Road into an integrated network of trade, welfare and military logistics across North India.

appearance.age_look: early 50s, solid and broad-shouldered, with the composed bearing of an experienced commander
appearance.face: oval face with a strong jaw, wheatish North Indian-Afghan complexion, deep-set sharp brown eyes, straight prominent nose, neatly trimmed medium beard and moustache, a few fine age lines at the forehead, default expression calm, decisive and slightly stern but compassionate
appearance.hair: dark brown hair mostly hidden beneath a tall, slightly conical Afghan-style turban: layered cotton in muted sandstone beige with a deep maroon cloth band wrapped around its base, a small gold turban ornament centered above his brow, no loose hair visible
appearance.costume: He wears a long Afghan-Indian jama (robe) of heavy matte cotton in warm olive green, reaching mid-calf, with a wrap-over front tied by an inner tie and outer deep maroon sash; the jama has simple round neckline, long fitted sleeves, and a subtle woven vertical stripe texture; over it, a sleeveless quilted waistcoat (nim-tana) in dull steel-grey with minimal stitching, fitting close to the torso; his sash (patka) in deep maroon is wrapped firmly at the waist and knotted on his left side, the loose end hanging with a narrow gold border; loose churidar-style trousers in undyed off-white cotton bunch neatly at the ankles; on his feet, sturdy brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes; he wears a plain gold signet ring on his right hand and a simple leather belt under the sash holding a small pouch, with no excessive jewellery, emphasizing functional, ruler-on-the-road practicality.
appearance.signature: A rolled parchment map of the Sadak-e-Azam secured in a leather case slung diagonally across his chest, which he often holds partially unrolled in his left hand, showing stylized route lines and sarai markers, while a sheathed straight-backed talwar with simple steel hilt hangs at his left hip from the belt.

ref_desc: Sher Shah Suri has a wheatish oval face with a medium beard, dark eyes, a sandstone beige turban with maroon band and gold ornament, olive green jama, steel-grey waistcoat, maroon sash, off-white trousers, brown mojari shoes, and a diagonal leather-slung road map case with talwar at his hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Sher Shah Suri standing in a neutral pose: an early-50s, broad-shouldered Afghan-Indian ruler with a wheatish oval face, deep brown eyes, straight nose, and neatly trimmed medium beard, looking calm and decisive. His dark hair is covered by a tall, slightly conical sandstone beige Afghan-style turban wrapped in layered cotton, with a deep maroon band at the base and a small gold ornament at the center of his brow. He wears a long, wrap-front olive green jama robe of heavy matte cotton with subtle vertical stripe texture, long fitted sleeves, and hem reaching mid-calf, tied inside and then firmly belted with a deep maroon sash knotted on his left, the loose end edged with a narrow gold border. Over the jama, show a sleeveless, close-fitting quilted waistcoat in dull steel-grey, simple and functional. His churidar-style trousers are off-white, slightly bunched at the ankles, and his footwear is sturdy brown leather mojari shoes with modest upturned toes. A plain gold signet ring is on his right hand, and a simple leather belt under the sash supports a sheathed straight-backed talwar with an unornamented steel hilt hanging at his left hip. Most important, show his signature leather map case slung diagonally across his chest, from right shoulder to left hip, with the end of a rolled parchment map visible; in one hand he lightly holds the partially unrolled map as if studying the road network. Use olive green, deep maroon, steel grey, off-white and brown leather as the dominant colours, and present him clearly from head to toe so this costume and gear can be consistently redrawn in many panels.
